from datetime import date
today = date.today()
start = today.replace(day=1).isoformat()
end = today.isoformat()
with get_db() as conn:
    ps = reports.get_period_summary(conn, start_date=start, end_date=end, owner_id='quintin')
print(ps)
expected = ccl.savings_rate(ps['total_income'], ps['total_spending'])
print('expected savings_rate:', expected)

results.description: Every freshness hours_since_last_sync is >= 0 and <= reasonable upper bound (90 days = 2160h)
results.query_or_script:
from dal import freshness
from dal.connection import get_db
with get_db() as conn:
    # Try owner-scoped first; falls back to household if owner-scoped errors
    try:
        rows = freshness.get_institution_freshness(conn, owner_id='quintin')
    except Exception as e:
        print('owner-scoped failed:', e, '-- falling back to household')
        rows = freshness.get_institution_freshness(conn)
for r in rows:
    print(r.get('institution_id'), r.get('hours_since_update'), r.get('staleness'))
